summary: Blue Bird Corp, through a wholly-owned subsidiary as plan sponsor, entered into an agreement with Pacific Life to purchase group annuity contracts and transfer pension obligations for 2,044 participants. The transaction is funded solely by Plan assets with no additional company funding; the premium is confidential but less than total Plan assets. Expected close is May 19, 2026, with Pacific Life assuming benefit obligations as of August 1, 2026. This is a routine pension risk transfer, not a special situation transaction. No price per share, premium, or activist involvement is present. What to watch: no risk-arb angle as this is purely an operational derisking event.
